aggregate_tone: The Indian industrial products sector is expected to see steady demand growth in Q4FY26, driven by strong end-market demand and cost savings efforts.
demand_picture: While companies like Sambhv and BORORENEW are cautiously optimistic on H2, SBCL expects a mid-single digit percentage growth in Q4FY26 due to strong demand in the solar energy segment.
margin_picture: The sector's margin trajectory is expected to remain stable, with gross margins ranging from 25-26% and EBITDA margins forecasted at 18-19%.
capex_picture: Capex behaviour across companies is consistent, with Sambhv maintaining its capex guidance of 10-15 crore year-on-year, while BORORENEW has allocated ₹1,000 crore for Q4FY26.
divergences: [ SBCL's cautious optimism on H2 vs. Sambhv's neutral tone ]
key_callouts: - SBCL's forecasted gross margin of 25-26% is higher than Sambhv's expected range of 24-25%. - BORORENEW's allocation of ₹1,000 crore for Q4FY26 is lower than Sambhv's guidance.
